g.text: Test 1: the average seller payoff is positive under every standard-error method

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Data: Cboe via FRED (VIXCLS); S&P 500 via Yahoo Finance. Sign: implied − realised (positive = variance seller gains). Monthly 2003–2025 (n = 267). Newey–West 6 lags; circular block bootstrap (6-month blocks, 10,000 resamples). Blue = 95% CI excludes 0.
